points.description: States the core fact: the best case takes N operations (N being the length of the array), which happens when the array is already sorted.
points.partial_credit: 2 to 4 marks for a related statement with half the fact, such as the best case being linear or N operations without the sorted condition, or the sorted condition without the N count.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating the core fact in any wording: N operations (the array length) in the best case, where the array is already sorted. Give 2 to 4 for a related answer that has only half of it, such as "linear time" or "when the array is sorted" with no count. Give 0 to 2 for answers that talk about insertion sort in general or give the worst-case count without stating the fact.
